root_cause.text: `mt7915_unregister_device()` freed `dev->coredump.crash_data` in `mt7915_coredump_unregister()` without first synchronizing the asynchronous `dev->dump_work`, so `mt7915_mac_dump_work()` could still run or be pending and dereference the freed `crash_data` causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description says the UAF happens when `mt7915_pci_remove()` calls `mt7915_unregister_device()` and `mt7915_coredump_unregister()` does `vfree(dev->coredump.crash_data)` while `mt7915_reset()` may have queued `dump_work`; the patch fixes this by adding `cancel_work_sync(&dev->dump_work);` before `mt7915_coredump_unregister(dev)`.

intent_record.how: This ensures any pending dump_work is fully canceled and completed before device teardown continues, preventing the work item from running after associated device resources may have been removed.
